evidence.note: Introduces the Gated Memory Unit, a mechanism for sharing memory readout states across layers, and uses it to build SambaY, a decoder-hybrid-decoder architecture whose 3.8B instance (Phi4-mini-Flash-Reasoning) matches or beats Phi4-mini-Reasoning on math and science benchmarks while decoding up to 10x faster on 32K-token generations.
evidence.title: Decoder-Hybrid-Decoder Architecture for Efficient Reasoning with Long Generation
